name: Serious Sam HD: The Second Encounter

achievements.name: Serious Beginner
achievements.description: Complete any level in single player.

achievements.name: Game Master
achievements.description: Complete the game.

achievements.name: Serious Sam
achievements.description: Complete the game in single player on serious difficulty.

achievements.name: Serious Run
achievements.description: Complete the game in single player by beating estimated time on each level.

achievements.name: Matador
achievements.description: Kill 50 Syrian Werebulls with a knife.

achievements.name: Look, it's a secret
achievements.description: Find at least 80 secrets in single player.

achievements.name: Cathedral King
achievements.description: Complete The Grand Cathedral level on serious difficulty without dying or loading.

achievements.name: Sam I am
achievements.description: Accumulate a total of 100,001 enemy kills and frags combined.

achievements.name: Co-op Beginner
achievements.description: Complete any level in at least 3 player cooperative game.

achievements.name: Coin-op Co-op
achievements.description: Complete a Coin-op cooperative game on normal or higher difficulty.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Beginner
achievements.description: Complete a deathmatch game with at least 1 frag.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Master
achievements.description: Win 100 deathmatch games.

achievements.name: Rocket Jumper
achievements.description: Perform 100 rocket jumps.

achievements.name: Burn Baby, Burn
achievements.description: Burn 500 enemies to death.

achievements.name: South America Master
achievements.description: Complete the South America episode in single player or cooperative.

achievements.name: Persia Master
achievements.description: Complete the Persia episode in single player or cooperative.

achievements.name: Medieval Master
achievements.description: Complete the Medieval episode in single player or cooperative.

achievements.name: Top Secret
achievements.description: Find all secrets in single player.

achievements.name: Bird Hunter
achievements.description: Kill 100 Harpies with the Sniper rifle.

achievements.name: Space Marine
achievements.description: Kill 1000 enemies with the Laser gun.

achievements.name: Bone Crusher
achievements.description: Kill 300 Kleers with the Cannon.

achievements.name: Rocket Man
achievements.description: Get all 3 Rocket launchers in Palenque - Sierra de Chiapas.

achievements.name: Balls of Steel
achievements.description: Find all 3 Cannons in Teotihuacan - The City of the Gods.

achievements.name: Braveheart
achievements.description: Deliver the final blow to Mordekai with the Knife.

achievements.name: Look Ma, I won!
achievements.description: Win a Deathmatch.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Champion
achievements.description: Win 1000 Deathmatch games.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Veteran
achievements.description: Complete 100 Deathmatches.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Duelist
achievements.description: Win 25 1-on-1 Deathmatches.

achievements.name: Untouchable
achievements.description: Win an at least 4 player Deathmatch by reaching frag limit of at least 25 without dying.

achievements.name: Fragger
achievements.description: Frag a total of 100 players.

achievements.name: Crazy Fragger
achievements.description: Frag a total of 500 players.

achievements.name: Serious Fragger
achievements.description: Frag a total of 1000 players.

achievements.name: 1337 Fragger
achievements.description: Frag a total of 1337 players.

achievements.name: Desperate Fragger
achievements.description: Frag 25 players with a knife while having no more than 10 health left.

achievements.name: Butcher
achievements.description: Frag 100 players with a knife.

achievements.name: Swordsman
achievements.description: Frag 100 players in a knife-to-knife fight.

achievements.name: Backstabber
achievements.description: Frag 100 players with a knife from behind.

achievements.name: Diverse Fragger
achievements.description: Frag 100 different players.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Marathon
achievements.description: Complete a Deathmatch with frag limit set to at least 200. (Frag limit must be reached!)

achievements.name: Deathmatch Marathon Winner
achievements.description: Win a Deathmatch Marathon.

achievements.name: Grudge
achievements.description: Frag the same player 5 times in a row in at least 4 player match.

achievements.name: Nemesis
achievements.description: Frag the same player 10 times during a single round in at least 4 player match.

achievements.name: Frag Combo
achievements.description: Perform 4 frags with each being no more than 10 seconds apart from the previous frag in at least 4 player Deathmatch.

achievements.name: Royal Frag Combo
achievements.description: Frag all players in a single frag combo.

achievements.name: Coin-op Life Saver
achievements.description: Pick up at least 10 extra life items in Cooperative Coin-op game.

achievements.name: Coin-op Gold Rush
achievements.description: Pick up 100 gold coins in Coin-op Cooperative game.

achievements.name: Beast Hunt Beginner
achievements.description: Win a Beast Hunt match on any level.

achievements.name: Beast Hunt Master
achievements.description: Win a Beast Hunt match on all game levels.

achievements.name: Team Beast Hunt Beginner
achievements.description: Win a Team Beast Hunt match on any level with least 2 players on each team.

achievements.name: Team Beast Hunt Master
achievements.description: Win a Team Beast Hunt match on all game levels with least 2 players on each team.

achievements.name: Capture The Flag Beginner
achievements.description: Win a CTF match with at least 2 players on each team.

achievements.name: Capture The Flag Master
achievements.description: Win 25 CTF matches with at least 2 players on each team.

achievements.name: Flag Thief
achievements.description: Score a total of 100 points in CTF matches.

achievements.name: Instant Kill Beginner
achievements.description: Make at least 3 kills in one Instant Kill match.

achievements.name: Instant Kill Master
achievements.description: Win 100 Instant Kill matches.

achievements.name: Instant Kill Pro
achievements.description: Frag 10 players without being killed in at least 4 player Instant Kill match.

achievements.name: Last Man Standing Beginner
achievements.description: Win one round in Last Man Standing game with at least 4 players.

achievements.name: Last Man Standing Master
achievements.description: Win 100 Last Man Standing matches with at least 4 players.

achievements.name: Last Team Standing Beginner
achievements.description: Earn a round for your team in Last Team Standing game with at least 2 players on each team.

achievements.name: My Burden Beginner
achievements.description: Win one My Burden match with at least 3 players.

achievements.name: My Burden Master
achievements.description: Win 100 My Burden matches with at least 3 players.

achievements.name: Heavy Weight Champion
achievements.description: Hold the Burden for at least 10 minutes in My Burden match with at least 3 players.

achievements.name: Team Deathmatch Beginner
achievements.description: Win one Team Deathmatch with at least 2 players on each team.

achievements.name: Team Deathmatch Master
achievements.description: Win 100 Team Deathmatches with at least 2 players on each team.

achievements.name: Survival Beginner
achievements.description: Earn at least a bronze medal on any level in single player Survival.

achievements.name: Survival Master
achievements.description: Earn gold medals on all Survival levels in single player Survival.

achievements.name: Cooperative Survival Beginner
achievements.description: Earn at least a bronze medal on any level in cooperative Survival.

achievements.name: Cooperative Survival Master
achievements.description: Earn gold medals on all Survival levels in cooperative Survival.

achievements.name: Last Team Standing Master
achievements.description: Win 100 Last Team Standing matches with at least 2 players on each team.

achievements.name: Treasure Diving
achievements.description: Find a secret under water.
